result.note: Without clipping or gaps this is the randomized innovation offset, not an actual cwnd counterfactual. With clipping/gaps reconstruction alone does not identify innovations. Randomized response includes compensation, CUBIC and future feedback; it is not dQ/da.

limitations: Static 27,436-row replay reused many times (about 750 draws per row after 40k updates; overfitting possible beyond ~10k). H-step and Poisson-weighted returns follow the behavior policy; the critic estimates the deterministic policy. Sign changes are compared per RTT x delay class; the 2-BDP scaling of the predicted times is approximate (+-50%).
